mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payroll growth exceeding 200k signals strong labor market demand, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k in a single month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC drops below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based recovery in consumer demand, which increases corporate revenue visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 1.5% MoM in the same month
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below its 12-month moving average indicates weakening supply-side activity, which signals economic contraction and triggers risk-off behavior, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below its 12-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal's Rank IC remains below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index (CPI) above 3.0% year-over-year, combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate, signals inflationary pressure that triggers central bank hawkishness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in real personal consumption expenditures (as proxied by RSAFS) combined with a rising unemployment rate indicates weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines > 1.0% MoM and UNRATE increases > 0.2pp MoM
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 65% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is not below -0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 9.5% signals a labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during high-unemployment periods (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal's Rank IC remains above -0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real GDP (GDPC1) in a quarterly report, combined with a drop in housing starts, indicates a contraction in aggregate demand, which triggers equity market sell-offs and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines > 0.5% QoQ and HOUST declines > 2.0% MoM
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.
